title: World Bloom — Break Down the Wall

meta.Outline: Vivid BAD SQUAD continue their intensive training, set on surpassing RAD WEEKEND. But one day in the Street SEKAI, a new area suddenly appears: an unfamiliar plaza, in which stands a huge wall...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Like I was saying on the way over, this live house is on the same level as Rodin, where you all performed the other day.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Not only that, some of the teams you're going to see are signed to major labels. Get ready for a tough battle.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
That being said...
I believe you all have what it takes to win now.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Like Akito said to the entire city, we're gonna surpass RAD WEEKEND during our next event. This is all for that.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Then, give it absolutely everything you've got. Leave nothing behind.

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: <Next up, we've got Vivid BAD SQUAD!>

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Alright, you guys, show them what you've got! I'll do the same when I go next!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! We're gonna give it everything we've got!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Whew!
Talk about an exhausting day!!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I'm tired too...
All the other teams were so good...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But I'm really glad we still won.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I couldn't believe it when they couldn't decide on a winner and asked us to sing another song... But that might've been our best performance yet.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: I still can't believe how good you guys have become. I mean, you went toe-to-toe with an amazing team like them.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You say that, but try not to forget that you also went all out today.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Well, I figure I at least need to match you guys for passion... Since I can't match your skill, and I need to do everything I can to catch back up to you after being out of action for so long.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, we'll be counting on you.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, Dad, that reminds me.
About practice after this...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Yeah, sorry.
I completely forgot that I have to go meet with the owner of COL...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: You've all had a pretty taxing day, so why don't you all call it a day here?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Use this time to do whatever you like.
You can practice by yourselves, work on those tasks I assigned all of you or do something else.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Alright, just try not to push yourselves too hard.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I'd like to work on my task...
But my pitch today during the chorus is still bothering me. I think I'd like to practice that part first.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Okay!
What are you gonna do, Kotaro?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: I'm gonna head back and practice on my own. My little brother's been asking me to come home early when I can.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Your little brother must love you very much. I hope you two get to spend a lot of time together today.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Me too! So, I'll see you guys tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Then, I'll take a short break before practicing...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I had a feeling it was you, Len.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Oh, you're all here!
Are you guys free to talk right now?!>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
S-Sure.
But why the hurry? What's wrong?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Whoa...! This is so cool!
It's like a big plaza!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
You're right...
This place is completely new...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's huge. And it just appeared overnight?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hi, Rin!
Oh, everyone's with you!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, what's the deal with this place...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
We're still not sure either.
Luka just brought us over.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I see.
But how or why did just appear like this?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hmm... I can't say for sure...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But your feelings may have something to do with it.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, our feelings created this new area? Is that actually possible...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: SEKAI was born out of your feelings, so it doesn't seem like too much of a stretch to say that strong feelings can cause it to transform.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But our feelings haven't changed that much or anything...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah.
Our goal's still the same.
To surpass RAD WEEKEND...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, but taking a look around may help us figure out what feelings went into this place being created. After all, those feelings should manifest in some way in SEKAI!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What feelings went into this place...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(The plaza's so big...
There's a lot of graffiti on the walls—)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, um...
It's just that the wall of that big building over there seemed a little funny.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, it is a bit odd...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Most of it is covered in flyers and graffiti, but the middle is completely devoid of anything for some reason...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Almost like there's a hole in it.
But why...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, it is kinda weird, but we don't have enough information to work with right now...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, why don't we try searching for clues somewhere else?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I agree. We should get the lay of the land first... We can start with one of these alleyways.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Whoa!!
This place is totally different from the streets we're used to!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah.
It's like we're suddenly overseas...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, this resembles the streets of Boston.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes.
When I was little, my dad held a concert over there and I got to go with him. This is very similar to what I saw that time.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh...
Now that you mention it, one of the other alleys I saw from the plaza looked like a street in Mexico I saw in a book of photos when I was little.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Then, does that mean we're standing in the middle of a collection of streets from around the world...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It's so cool how we get to see all these different sights! Let's keep exploring, you guys!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It isn't safe to rush like that, you two.

rows.Speaker: Rin's Voice
rows.Line: There's a huge wall blocking the way!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
There's plenty of buildings around here...
But this wall's taller than all of them.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
And it looks very sturdy.
No windows or passageways either. Almost like a castle wall.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
But why's this path blocked?
There's no way ahead.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hmm...
Wanna try finding a way around it?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes.
There were many ways out of the plaza, so one will surely take us around this.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Then, let's try that side alley over there.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I wasn't expecting to find another giant wall here...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I just tried one of the other alleys, but it was also blocked by a wall!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Could it be that all these alleyways are blocked by this one wall?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So, we won't be able to see what's on the other side? I was hoping to see if we could find out what feelings went into making this place...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Still, what's with this wall?
They don't seem natural at all.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I agree.
It's as if it suddenly sprang up to block our way.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Did this wall also come from our feelings?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I mean, it's pretty prominent.
Why else would it exist, you know?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Right... Yes, that might be worth keeping in mind.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But what sort of feelings would lead to this wall being created...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: If I recall correctly, it's common for walls to appear in a person's dreams when they're feeling stressed or pressured in some way.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I guess we might be feeling some pressure lately... We did say that we're going to surpass RAD WEEKEND no matter what.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
This wall...
It represents how we feel about RAD WEEKEND...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, that is a distinct possibility.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It makes sense if you think how huge it is, like no one could ever even think to try getting over it.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: These streets from around the world may also be relevant to that.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Remember what you said you're going to do after you surpass RAD WEEKEND?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We're gonna go beyond Aunt Nagi's dream. In other words...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We're gonna stand on top of the world...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I don't know for sure, but that's my guess.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: If we do manage to surpass RAD WEEKEND, then we'll be able to see even more of SEKAI on the other side of this wall?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I'm starting to like this place.
All your dreams have a tangible shape here.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Alright!
Now that we know what kind of feelings helped produce this place, let's try exploring all these alleys!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Oh, nice idea!
Strolling around streets from around the world is bound to be fun!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, we can visit all those streets and visualize what it'll be like when we take on the world!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Then, let's take a walk.
I do wanna go back and check out that last alley.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Me too.
I'm still curious about the one I spotted from the plaza earlier.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, there's also one that caught my eye...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hmm... Checking out all of them is gonna take pretty long, so why don't we split up and meet back in the plaza later?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sounds good. That way, we'll still be able to have practice.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Then, let's give ourselves thirty minutes to explore and meet back in the plaza afterwards.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wow...!
This alley looks totally different from the last one!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, you're right.
This looks a lot like a street from Argentina.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh? What makes you say that?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I vaguely remember seeing a place like this a few times on TV when I was a kid...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Another alley, another wall.
And it's so big...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah.
It looks just as sturdy as the other ones we saw.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Len, isn't that the soccer ball Akito gave you that time?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hmm... No, I don't think so.
I didn't bring it with me, and I don't recognize these stains.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Then...
Does that mean someone's feelings also made this?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
This too...?
Is there anything our feelings can't make?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Wait, Akito, I bet this was made out of your feelings!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Because you used to play soccer!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: How does that lead to this soccer ball?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Because... Oh!
Because you love playing soccer so much?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I think you're grasping at straws.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But it probably has to do with you, right? I don't think Kohane and the others used to play soccer.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Still... What kind of feelings could have made it?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What if we played soccer together?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Playing with it might help shake some things loose in your mind!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Also, I've been wanting to try playing soccer for a while now! Len always looks like he's having so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait, that sounds like your actual goal here.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: That's just the way Rin is.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But if there is a chance that playing soccer will help you realize something, then it might be worth a try!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Got it...!
So we're really doing this?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I still don't think playing soccer here is gonna help. Exploring the other alleys seems like the better option.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah, I get that!
But let's keep playing for a bit!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Akito, pass me the ball!
Got it. Now, check out my...tornado shot!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: All you're doing is raising your leg a little higher than normal.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Whoa, hey!
The ball flew way over there!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh no!
I'm really sorry, Akito! Can you go get it?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
The flier on that wall over there.
Why does it look so familiar...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, for an event I performed in way back when.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wait, but...
I don't see “Vivid BAD SQUAD” written anywhere.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Well, it did happen a long time ago.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: This was from back when I was in middle school. I entered by myself.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh...!
You mean the thing that Luka and the others mentioned the other day...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah...
The event where I dragged Crawl Green's name through the mud...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What if my painful emotions from back then are manifesting in SEKAI?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Before I started singing, I played soccer... But I hit a huge wall.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And now I've found a flyer of an event where I messed up.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (The first time was with soccer when I got shown just how unprepared I really was.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(Then, I saw RAD WEEKEND.
I decided to start singing instead, but it didn't go as planned. One dumb argument led to me dragging that place's name through the mud.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (After that, I met Toya and started practicing like there was no tomorrow. Even then, everyone kept making fun of us.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I managed to finally get this far... But I fell at so many hurdles.)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: In that respect, Akito, you're an amazing person.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Huh?
Where's this coming from all of a sudden?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Because you always keep trying no matter how hard things get...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: And now, your singing's so good it reignited all of Vivid Street!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I mean, if I went through what you did, I'd probably have given up the first chance I could!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Exactly!
Not giving up is really hard!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
And you never did.
You just kept blazing your own trail.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Again, that's really amazing...and really cool!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I've never really thought of it that way.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I didn't think I had any other choice is all.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I couldn't quit. I couldn't show any weakness. Not after I decided I was gonna surpass that night. I'd never have forgiven myself if I did...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Which is why I can't see myself as being “cool”.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I mean, I've gotten better, but I'm still nowhere near my goal...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I was able to sing with absolutely everything I had that time.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Which helped me figure out how to make everyone realize that we're serious...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I feel like I'm finally on the same level as them.)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
What the...?
Hey, Akito, check out the wall!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: There's a big empty white box on it now! It wasn't there a second ago!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hmm... Is it just me, or does it look like a soccer goal?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, it's about the right size...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (But why's a drawing of a goal appearing instead of an actual one?)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (It's like it wants me to kick the ball at that spot.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Len, pass that ball to me...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: To give it the attention it deserves.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I thought this flyer and ball appeared because of what I felt in the past.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I kept trying in the face of pain.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I kept pushing forward despite what I was feeling. I was determined to succeed.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (And that determination is what's manifesting here.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(All the times I messed up, all that pain...
It's telling me to take what I felt and use it to break down this wall.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I know I'm gonna come across more walls in the future.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
But they won't stop me.
I'll always find a way through.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That's why I'm gonna keep doing everything I can to make that happen.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Whoa...!
You did a tornado shot!!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No, that was just a regular mid-range shoot.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But it was so fast! That was really cool, Akito!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hm...?
Hey, did you guys hear that just now?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It sounded like something hard just cracked...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Look! There's a crack in the wall!!!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
She's right!
Akito, did you actually do a tornado shot?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No, there's no way I kicked it that hard!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, this one looks really pretty!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, it is.
I'm reminded of the streets in Hamburg.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Did your dad also do a concert there?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, a number of times.
However, this feels more downtown than the streets I walked on then.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Look at all the flyers on the walls!
They're so fun and colorful.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, they are.
Their designs are interesting and... Hm?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's a flyer for Gurney flap...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, that's the name of Tono and Soma's team...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But what's their flyer doing here in SEKAI...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (On closer inspection, it seems only their team name is written here.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (There's no information regarding when or where it is, or who else is performing. Not only that, it's starting to fall off.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: “What if Soma stops making new songs for him...?”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: This may be a product of those thoughts.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It's true that anxieties like that could also manifest themselves here...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (When I visited Soma in the hospital after Tono disappeared...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I was worried that I'd never see Tono sing Soma's songs again.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: A little while back, KAITO, you told me that we share some similarities with Soma and Tono...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You said you saw similarities in how he cares about his partner very much and seems very serious about surpassing RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: So, Arata, let me ask you this. Who are you really singing for?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: You're not trying to make Soma's dreams come true. You can't face the pain of having lost him, so you're just clinging to his dreams.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But I've been thinking about that.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, Tono may be singing because he can't face that pain.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But... I'm certain there's more to it than just that. There must be.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He cares about the dream that Soma shared with him more deeply than anything.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Just as Akito shared his dream with me, which I now care deeply about.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Just watching the two of them talking made that...painfully clear.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So, I'm going to complete the task Ken gave me and tell Tono and the others about it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: In order to get them to return.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, this is wonderful! I'm starting to get all fired up!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Not only that, this flyer specifically appeared in SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I have a feeling that it doesn't come from a place of worry. I think it comes from your desire to surpass RAD WEEKEND with Tono and the others.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, I see.
Thank you for saying that, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, it's just... I noticed that there's a strange flyer posted on the wall behind you, KAITO...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
A strange flyer?
Huh...? No, this is...something else.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I think it's for the piano.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Wow, this looks hard.
I don't think I have enough fingers for this.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
What's this song called?
Let's see... The title says...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: This is sheet music for Chopin's Fantaisie-Impromptu.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
What?!
You can tell just by glancing at it?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, um... Another piece may not have been so obvious, but this one...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I practiced playing it so much when I was little.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
That means...
This sheet music might also have come from your feelings.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I remember spending every single day sitting at the piano.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Despite the fatigue, I had to keep my fingers moving... My vision even went blurry from time to time.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (So hard that I found myself hating music itself.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But I'm able to keep moving forward today because of what I experienced back then.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (That also applies to the task Ken gave me.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: About the task you helped me the other day with... I think I know what I need to do now.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I should be able to produce some results now, so I hope you'll be looking forward to that.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: If you're willing to say that, Toya, then I think there's nothing for me to worry about!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: However, it is a bit unfortunate...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: How you've got such a good head on your shoulders!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Why is it unfortunate that I have a good head on my shoulders?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Because I don't have anything to do now!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I was hoping to help you all since you've been working so hard on your tasks, but it seems that I don't have anything to teach you, Toya...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Once again, you found the solution all on your own!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: In other words, I wish you'd lean on me more since I'm here in the first place to help you make your dreams a reality!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You've already helped me so much, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Whether it's making me laugh whenever something is bothering me, or inviting me to have a nice meal with you and MEIKO...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Your kindness has always allowed me to take a step back and relax...and given me a chance to think about how to tackle my problems.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So, KAITO, thank you for everything you've done for me.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Haha!
Wow, now I'm the one receiving all the encouragement!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Still, I'm glad to hear that I've been able to help you.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
You have.
And I'll be asking you for more help in the future.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'll do everything I can to make sure you're all able to go beyond that giant wall!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you.
With that in mind...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I promise to surpass RAD WEEKEND!
And—

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Hm?
Did you hear that sound?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, it seemed like it came from over by the wall...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
...!
KAITO, there's a crack in it...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
What?!
Wow, and a fairly big one too!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(This wall...
It must have something to do with how we see RAD WEEKEND in our minds...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But I think our desire to overcome the obstacle in front of us—to see what's beyond—is what caused this crack to form in the wall.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes, I see...!
So when you do find a way to overcome it, then maybe it'll crumble to pieces!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Hehe. You may be right.
In any case...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I want to see what's beyond it as soon as I can.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
An, is something bothering you?
You've been staring up at that wall for a while now.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh! Hi, Miku...!
Haha. You caught me.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
How do I put it...?
Knowing that this is how we perceive RAD WEEKEND has me thinking about a lot.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Aunt Nagi and everyone really did put on a legendary event.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And I'll need to do what I have to to make that happen.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Do you think you'll be able to?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: All that's left for me to do is act when the time comes.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I still don't have an answer for the thing that's really got me hung up.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We're gonna surpass RAD WEEKEND and see what it's like beyond that dream. We're gonna do the thing Aunt Nagi didn't get to. I don't have any doubt about that.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But I still don't know what to do about how I feel about Kohane...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
She's my partner...
She means more to me than anyone else...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Because I wanna keep up with her.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I wanna get closure on this before we surpass RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Because we definitely won't be able to if I still have lingering doubts.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'll be keeping an eye on how you deal with this.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So, I'll be looking forward to seeing some nice results.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thanks! I hope you'll be ready then!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey... Did you hear that just now?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
...!
There's a crack in the wall!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
A pretty big one too...
But why now all of a sudden...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (But it doesn't sound like Kohane or any of the others. Who could it—)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
It can't be...
But, it is...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(What's she doing here?!
I mean, she's...!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (But if she is, who was that...?)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(If so...
Was that Aunt Nagi like a ghost or something...?)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(That's weird...
She's just walking like nothing's happening, but...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I'm running as fast as I can, but I can't seem to catch up...!)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Could it be because this Nagi came from her feelings?)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Argh!
She won't wait for me at all...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I-I'm okay! Just a small scrape!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Honestly... It's just like you to do this, Aunt Nagi!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: When you watch me practice, you always run off to someone else when they ask you to!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Whenever we have dinner together, you always move to the living room to watch TV as soon as you finish!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Can't you at least stop for me in SEKAI?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
(It looks like she's staring at something.
But what...?)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, um...
It's just that the wall of that big building over there seemed a little funny.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, it is a bit odd...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Most of it is covered in flyers and graffiti, but the middle is completely devoid of anything for some reason...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Almost like there's a hole in it.
But why...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I finally managed to catch up to her, but I have no idea what to say...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (There's a ton of stuff I need to tell her and ask her about...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Haha...
Just when I finally got my chance to talk to her again, I couldn't say anything...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It's the one we used to sing together...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: She always sings like she's having so much fun...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'll catch up to you soon!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm gonna come charging towards you!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And I'm gonna fly right past you. So...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You better be ready, Aunt Nagi!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I feel a lot better now!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm really glad for you, An.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I still don't understand why Nagi stared at that wall the way she did.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, now that you mention it...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (That wall in the plaza is the only one we still don't really know anything about...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But I think all this walking around has given me a better understanding of this area.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Yes.
These alleyways all seem to extend outward from that central plaza.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And that wall is encircling it.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I see...
So no matter which alley we go down, we'll hit a dead end.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
That's unfortunate.
I really want to see what's on the other side of this wall.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Kohane and the others will likely need to surpass RAD WEEKEND for that to happen.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(This is how we see RAD WEEKEND.
This is what this wall represents...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Does that mean what lies beyond Nagi and her team's dream is waiting for us on the other side?)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (To stand on top of the world...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (It's such a huge goal, now that I think about it...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I mean, we've been having to work so hard just to win the events we're entering into now...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Even so... We have to find a way over this wall.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Because we won't get to see what's on the other side if we don't.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Huh...?!
Sorry, I was just going over it all...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I knew it wouldn't be easy...
But I didn't think we'd have to face such a huge wall...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, it is a bit overwhelming when you see it right in front of you.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
However, I wouldn't worry.
I'm sure you'll all figure out a way.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Nagi, Ken, all the locals...
You're determined to carry all their dreams forward.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Right.
We've already made our decision.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: There's no turning back for us.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It doesn't matter how scary or unsettling things get... We're going to surpass RAD WEEKEND no matter what.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
For the sake of our team.
For the sake of Nagi, her team, everyone...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You've become such a strong girl...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But, don't forget about the others, okay?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: When someone's carrying a big load, it's easy for them to forget about those around them.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: They feel that they need to do everything themselves.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah, you're right...
I may have felt that way for a second there.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. It's not necessarily a bad thing.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But everyone will always support you in any way they can when you get stuck.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
She's right, Kohane!
I'll help you out in whatever ways I can!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you very much, MEIKO, Luka!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'll do my best to remember that we're all in this together.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We're going to surpass RAD WEEKEND!!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Huh...?!
There's a crack in the wall...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Wh-Why did this crack form all of the sudden...?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: What if it's a response to Kohane's declaration?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: If this wall represents how you all see RAD WEEKEND, then it makes sense for it to be big, tall and immovable.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But you just said that you're going to surpass it, right, Kohane? You were able to visualize going to see what's beyond it.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That might've caused this crack to form.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What I said made it crack...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No, um... I thought I heard music coming from this crack...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, you're right! I hear it too!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Is this crack allowing this music to come through the wall?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It sounds like a fun song.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
*Nod*
It's got a Latin rhythm to it!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I suppose it only makes sense since this alley also has that sort of feel to it.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Haha! That'd be so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Be it America, India, wherever...!
If an alley looks like it's from a certain part of the world, then we'd get to hear music from that region, right?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. That would mean there's all sorts of music we've never heard before waiting for us on the other side.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No, I just thought of something...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: If we do end up surpassing RAD WEEKEND and cause this wall to come crumbling down...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I have a feeling that music from all around the world will come together in the plaza back there.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
You may be right.
It does lie at the center of this area...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Imagine getting to hear all the music that the world has to offer! How wonderful would that be?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Actually...
I may have had the wrong idea about this place.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Originally, I thought this place was the new starting point for your journey as you strive towards seeing what's beyond that dream.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: However, Kohane, if what you say is correct, then it's more than that...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: This may be where you all come into contact with music from around the world.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: With music from around the world?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: When this wall comes down, you'll get to hear all that music.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And through that, you'll get to learn new things and continue to grow.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And that will help you stand on top of the world. That's what this place is for.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I can't explain why, MEIKO, but what you said is just what I needed to hear...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We're going to surpass RAD WEEKEND, this wall will come down, we'll get to learn about all this music from around the world and keep growing...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It's such an exciting thought! This place is going to be so incredible!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Haha!
Look how bold you are, Kohane.
You sound so eager to set out into the unknown.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, look at the time!
We should start making our way back to the plaza.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Okay!
Let's go meet back up with everyone, MEIKO, Luka!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I knew that surpassing RAD WEEKEND wasn't going to be easy.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But I'm so excited about what we're going to see once this wall comes down.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (All that's left is for us to do it.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (We're going to break down this wall! Together!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So, this should be where we're supposed to meet. Where is everyone...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Welcome back!
How'd things on your end go?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, I think we figured something out...!
Mind listening for a bit while I explain?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, this place is where we're supposed to interact with music from all different countries, so we can stand on top of the world?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Interesting...
That didn't occur to me.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Me neither. I wouldn't have made that connection if it weren't for MEIKO...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But it sort of makes sense based on how this place's layout

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Which means this place is bigger than we realize. I kinda like that.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I saw Aunt Nagi just earlier.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I can't say for sure, but... I think I was able to see her because of what I was feeling.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: She looked exactly the way she did when I was little.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So our feelings can be reflected in that much depth? SEKAI really is a mysterious place...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Also, she was staring at that part of the wall over there with a kinda sad look on her face.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
That part...?
Oh, you mean the weird blank spot?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah.
Me and Miku talked about what we think that meant...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But I think you just gave me the answer, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: If this plaza's supposed to be filled with music from all around the world like you said...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Then all this graffiti, flyers and stuff we see around here must also mean something.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. That big blank spot in the middle...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I think it's reserved for the team that's standing on top of the world.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Music from around the world all in one place...with the name of our event etched in here.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And us standing on top of the world.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Can't you at least stop for me in SEKAI?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Nagi departed this world before she could make her dream come true... Before she could etch her name into that wall.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (And the people carrying the torch for her now are...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We're going to etch the name of our event in! Right in the center of the world!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We gotta we gotta break down this wall first...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Alright, that's settled...
So let's start practicing.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Right.
I feel like I can sing for hours on end.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, that's what I like to hear!
Then, let's sing until it's completely dark!!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hey, look!
What's that thing over by the edge of the plaza?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
You're right!
It's so adorably tiny!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Did their feelings also produce this?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: If so, then what sorts of feelings?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to seeing how it grows.
